scope: Learned-sharing proposal prior correctness and transfer selection. No trained-model mechanism discovery or measured CUDA speedup.
changes: Head conditionals only reference compatible earlier layers; every cross-layer pair remains available in one orientation.
Checkpoint restore rejects forward or cyclic head references transactionally.
Actual selected head components are counted; target-dependent gauge matrices and scales carry 64-bit literal charges.
Only operators participating in selected conditionals are downloaded and sampled per step; the operator list refreshes after each epoch selection.

counterexample.unit_mutual_scales: Positive mutual component is nonintegrable along x=y.
counterexample.directed_construction: A prior root and normalized conditional integrate to one; fixed earlier-layer order applies this recursively.
counterexample.test: Numerical quadrature of the implemented term: cyclic Z=13/12, directed Z=1 within 1e-9.

validation.merged_build_note: Two parallel dependency builds were terminated with SIGKILL before tests. Serial compilation with an explicit memory lease completed and all eight focused tests passed.

remaining_limitations: Other parameter-code charges remain asymptotic estimates; this is not a complete finite-bit coding proof.
Mixture pathwise gradients hold empirical-Bayes base variances fixed. Recomputing those variances from the posterior adds chain-rule terms not implemented here.
The selected mixture operations still run on CPU. Resident CUDA mixture kernels remain needed; transfer reduction is not a measured speedup.
The soft-sharing prior proposes candidates; final hard-sharing comparisons refit without that mixture prior. Existing hard-candidate scores should not be retroactively labeled cyclic-prior scores.
